messages:
anna-partnerships: Quick heads up — integrator SSO key rotation is scheduled for Tue 10:00 PDT. Marketplace listing needs to lock down the pen/scan acceptance callback flow before we rotate keys.

sam-security: Can you confirm acceptance checklist? Sec wants: retest report (PDF), repro & fix commit SHAs, CVE list (if any), and a signed proof-of-fix JSON from integrator.

anna-partnerships: Agreed. Partner asked for an automated webhook so their CI can receive pass/fail. They want HMAC-signed payloads originally.

jake-eng: I can add an endpoint on marketplace. Proposal: POST /integrations/pen-callback with header X-Marketplace-Signature. Payload: {"status": "pass|fail", "artifacts": [urls], "evidence": url}. We'll HMAC using rotated key. Example curl: 

```
curl -X POST https://marketplace.internal/integrations/pen-callback \\
  -H "X-Marketplace-Signature: sha256=..." \\
  -d '{"status":"pass","evidence":"https://s3.amazonaws.com/marketplace/evidence/123.pdf"}'
```

jake-eng: We'll include nonce+timestamp to prevent replay. Do we require partner to publish a public key or store a shared secret?

olivia-sis: Integrator prefers asymmetric validation. They don't want another long-lived symmetric secret. They can verify a signed JWT from Redwood (kid header) or accept server-cert-validated HTTPS callbacks.

sam-security: Asymmetric preferred. Sec requires JWT include iss/kid/exp and a checksum of the artifact list. For audit we keep the raw JWT and map to pen ticket. Also require retest PDF to be on versioned S3 path with presigned URL TTL.

maria-legal: Note: any callback containing customer IDs or PII must be redacted. Also we need an embargo clause in acceptance: integrator confirms no publicity until marketplace launch window.

anna-partnerships: We'll add embargoed_until field in proof-of-fix JSON. Proposed proof-of-fix example: {"pen_id":"PEN-2025-104","status":"pass","artifacts":["s3://marketplace/evidence/PEN-2025-104/retest.pdf"],"retest_report":"s3://marketplace/reports/PEN-2025-104.pdf","embargoed_until":"2025-08-14T16:00:00Z","signed_by":"Integrator Inc","signature":"base64sig"}.

sam-security: Add acceptance booleans: retest_ok, vuln_patch_ok, e2e_tests_ok. Callback CI should mark overall status fail if any are false. Also auto-retest policy: if a high CVE reappears within 30 days we'll auto-revoke listing.

jake-eng: Implementation plan: lightweight lambda to verify JWT signature -> fetch retest_report from S3 -> validate checksum against manifest -> publish to audit topic. Endpoint returns 202 then does async validation and posts final status to partner callback URL they provide.

anna-partnerships: Timeline: Jake to deliver endpoint by Mon EOD, partner to provide public key + callback URL by Tue 08:00, security to confirm JSON schema by Tue 09:30, key rotation Tue 10:00.

sam-security: I'll draft the JSON schema and share example. Also adding a manifest.json for artifacts containing filename -> sha256 mapping.

maria-legal: I'll draft embargo wording and include 72hr marketing notice for joint announcements. Keep language short and specific.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy.preview/marketplace/feature/pen-callback-impl-174 (staging). Webhook receiver up, cert chain valid. :rocket: 

anna-partnerships: Thanks — I'll ping integrator and return with sign-off once Jake and Sam confirm schema. :handshake:
